name: Tong Ju Qiao Nv Pu
source: The cafe run by the protagonist in the game needs to hire a maid because of personnel changes. Then a pair of twin sisters came to apply, namely Xiaoqing and Xiaoye. The protagonist of the story gradually develops a good impression of Xiaoye and develops love, and finally the two fall in love. But her sister Xiaoqing was unwilling, and the three eventually became a triangle relationship.
translation: 游戏中主角经营的咖啡馆因人事变动需要聘请女佣。这时有一对双胞胎姐妹来应聘，分别是小青和小叶。故事的主人公逐渐对小叶产生了好感并产生了爱情，最终两人坠入爱河。但妹妹小青不愿意，三人最终成了三角关系。
